recognize_zh: 周邊血液中三顆循環母細胞，核染色質細緻、核質比高，細胞質中等量藍色並在核旁有淡染區，未見明顯Auer小體；形態支持骨髓母細胞，但t(8;21)須靠細胞遺傳學確認。
features: Three circulating blasts, roughly twice the diameter of red cells
High N:C ratio with round to slightly indented nuclei
Fine, evenly dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with a paler paranuclear zone in some cells
No definite granules or Auer rods resolved
Background red cells normocytic with some overlap; platelets not prominent
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to slightly indented nuclei, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderately basophilic, and a paler paranuclear zone is seen in some cells. Definite granules or Auer rods are not identified at this resolution. Red cells appear normocytic. Findings are consistent with circulating myeloblasts; specific assignment to AML with t(8;21) requires cytogenetic or molecular confirmation of RUNX1::RUNX1T1.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts usually have scantier cytoplasm and more condensed chromatin, and t(8;21) AML often coexpresses CD19 and PAX5, so flow cytometry and cytogenetics are required.
Monoblasts and promonocytes have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with folded delicate nuclei and are nonspecific esterase positive.
A leukoerythroblastic picture shows nucleated red cells and a left-shifted spectrum of maturing myeloid cells rather than isolated monotonous blasts.
